DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Colitis

The recent hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction is the critical clue here. The sudden onset of periumbilical pain combined with bloody diarrhea in a 74-year-old male, even with currently normal labs, strongly suggests ischemic bowel injury secondary to reduced blood flow following his heart attack. Do you have a history of atrial fibrillation or any blood clotting disorders that might have contributed to this event?
